rachel: Heads up: new Next.js LangChain sample is confusing new users. Two things: SDK call shape mismatch and edge wasm load errors.
mike: details?
rachel: README shows `await client.embeddings.create()` but starter installs @redwood/inference-js@0.9.x which uses `client.createEmbedding`. Folks copy-paste and hit undefined.
jin: that's a docs pinning issue. Starter should pin SDK or update snippets.
aria: also saw `WebAssembly.instantiateStreaming is not a function` on Vercel Edge. We used instantiateStreaming without a safe arrayBuffer fallback.
rachel: quick fix: fallback to arrayBuffer + guard for TextEncoder/TextDecoder. But maybe better to run tokenization server-side by default.
mike: And the fetch retryer in starter treats 429 as fatal unless Retry-After set; hosted sandbox sometimes uses X-RateLimit-Reset so downloads fail.
jin: Action items: 1) update loader with instantiateStreaming -> arrayBuffer fallback + tiny polyfill, 2) pin or bump SDK to 0.10.x and update README, 3) make fetch retry respect 429 with Retry-After/X-RateLimit-Reset, 4) add a CI smoke test that emulates Edge.
aria: I'll open the PR with loader + README patch.
devex-bot: Branch created: fix/starter-sdk-wasm-retry
aria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/nextjs-langchain-starter/pull/45
devex-bot: PR #45 merged by aria  changelog: starter: wasm loader fallback, SDK bump to 0.10.2, retry logic fix.
rachel: closing thread. Thanks!
